Permits may be issued for a period of up to 2 years unless otherwise limited by law.
   Exception: Sidewalk shed permits shall be issued for a period of 90 days and may not be renewed until department penalties for sidewalk sheds in the public right-of-way are paid.
(Am. L.L. 2025/048, 4/17/2025, eff. 1/12/2026)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2025/048.
